params.why: the conditioning time. Both are run: the OLD value to reproduce the banked cell (P1), the NEW one to ask the question. Moving it is also the instrument for C2 -- a slow subpopulation that is real should not care where the cut is taken

params.name: k_grid
params.why: the old grid was designed on iid's k* ~ 11 and left GUE 3-4 assessable points at k* ~ 6. P2 scores whether the adaptation actually repairs that, rather than assuming it did

params.name: seed_class
